exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-21T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card --actor tester init --prefix show-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: show-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card --actor tester create 'Attachment origin'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt
exec card --actor tester create 'Other issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-other.txt

exec sh show-attachments.sh
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/workflow.txt
! stderr .

-- show-attachments.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

add_output=$(card --actor tester --json attachment add report.txt --issue show-1)
attachment_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$add_output" | jq -r '.id')

card --actor tester show show-2 >empty-human.out
printf '%s\n' \
  'ID: show-2' \
  'Title: Other issue' \
  'Type: task' \
  'Status: ready' \
  'Priority: 2' \
  'Assignee: -' \
  'Parent: -' \
  'Labels: -' \
  'Depends on: -' \
  'Blocks: -' \
  'Log entries: 0' \
  'Attachments: -' >empty-human.want
cmp empty-human.want empty-human.out

card --actor tester --json show show-2 >empty-json.out
printf '%s\n' \
  '{"id":"show-2","title":"Other issue","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":2,"active_claim":null,"created":1784635200,"updated":1784635200,"revision":3,"keys":[],"labels":[],"depends_on":[],"blocks":[],"log_count":0,"blocked":false,"parent_id":null,"attachments":[]}' >empty-json.want
cmp empty-json.want empty-json.out

card --actor tester attachment add other.txt --issue show-2 >/dev/null
card --actor tester attachment add board.txt >/dev/null

card --actor tester show show-1 >human.out
printf '%s\n' \
  'ID: show-1' \
  'Title: Attachment origin' \
  'Type: task' \
  'Status: ready' \
  'Priority: 2' \
  'Assignee: -' \
  'Parent: -' \
  'Labels: -' \
  'Depends on: -' \
  'Blocks: -' \
  'Log entries: 0' \
  "Attachments: $attachment_id (report.txt)" >human.want
cmp human.want human.out

card --actor tester --json show show-1 >json.out
printf '%s\n' \
  "{\"id\":\"show-1\",\"title\":\"Attachment origin\",\"type\":\"task\",\"lifecycle\":\"open\",\"status\":\"ready\",\"priority\":2,\"active_claim\":null,\"created\":1784635200,\"updated\":1784635200,\"revision\":4,\"keys\":[],\"labels\":[],\"depends_on\":[],\"blocks\":[],\"log_count\":0,\"blocked\":false,\"parent_id\":null,\"attachments\":[{\"id\":\"$attachment_id\",\"board_id\":\"board_00000000000000000000\",\"origin_issue_id\":\"show-1\",\"filename\":\"report.txt\",\"media_type\":\"text/plain; charset=utf-8\",\"digest\":\"sha256:e8d95d85d63087a2e60b4f189b38a03c10759143f6e01f5363b5ee6ce7ea3841\",\"size_bytes\":14,\"lifecycle\":\"active\",\"availability\":\"present_unverified\",\"created\":{\"actor\":\"tester\",\"at\":\"2026-07-21T12:00:00Z\",\"revision\":4},\"removed\":null}]}" >json.want
if ! cmp json.want json.out; then
  diff -u json.want json.out
  exit 1
fi

printf '%s\n' \
  'human show retains the empty attachment field' \
  'JSON show retains the empty attachment array' \
  'human show lists the associated attachment' \
  'JSON show includes complete associated attachment metadata'

-- report.txt --
bridge report
-- other.txt --
other issue
-- board.txt --
board attachment
-- golden/create.txt --
show-1
-- golden/create-other.txt --
show-2
-- golden/workflow.txt --
human show retains the empty attachment field
JSON show retains the empty attachment array
human show lists the associated attachment
JSON show includes complete associated attachment metadata
